workstreams.name: 240p / 288p and analog gamma
workstreams.status: Released; owner reports success. v1.6.0-dev6 pre-release adds single-SD-family support: dev5 passes the 480i+576i availability gate (PROVEN: owner PAL unit); dev6 falls back to AV head cache invalidation when the other SD family cannot be configured (UNKNOWN until an NTSC/component console reports; fails safe to stock). Wider connector/game coverage and electrical waveform measurement remain open.

workstreams.name: Sysmgr PID compatibility
workstreams.status: PROVEN in supplied external log: sysmgr PID 9 and all 54 targets resolved. CLAIMED: CECH-2004A 240p works; switching to ps1_netemu resolves its reported PS1 audio/crop issues.

workstreams.name: HDMI 540p
workstreams.status: PROVEN: full XMB picture and receiver-reported progressive output in timed dev19 test. UNKNOWN: HD CRT, component and game compatibility; no permanent enforcement.

workstreams.name: HDMI 240p / 288p
workstreams.status: CLAIMED: stock HDMI 480p is visible directly on the owner monitor. PROVEN: timed stock recovery and direct USB-video captures; both OBS and FFmpeg are black through the splitter/capture chain. UNKNOWN: failing link/card behavior and working HDMI 240p/288p; no low-line candidate applied.

workstreams.name: Resolution presets and scaling
workstreams.status: PROVEN: previous native PC/XGA XMB tests and revised in-app 1280x768 / 1024x768 previews with stock recovery. Unified five-mode preview/keep controller and GPU handshake pass offline checks. In-app 540p reached software preview but receiver had no signal; a corrected source-height candidate is built, untested. Live keep/enforcement, remaining app presets, scaling, games, component and HEN are unverified; repeated power outages interrupted testing.

workstreams.name: HEN diagnostic and port
workstreams.status: PROVEN: diagnostic builds and public-only CFW smoke pass. Additional native/gamma/mapping paths inspected offline; no ordinary-HEN 240p/288p route established. Actual HEN runtime untested.

workstreams.name: Community compatibility and measurements
workstreams.status: CLAIMED: external tester resolves PS1 audio/crop by selecting ps1_netemu; owner reports normal CRT audio. PROVEN: rc1 assets retain their checked digests; the unchanged rc1 build is now the official Latest SD release. UNKNOWN: exact emulator/setup difference, integer scaling and latency.

workstreams.name: SCART RGB DVD/Blu-ray green picture
workstreams.status: PROVEN: green = AV encoder in component mode; two LV1 patches force RGB output and remove the green (XMB unaffected). PROVEN: the encoder has no YCbCr-to-RGB conversion (letterbox bars turn magenta) and RSX scanout byte 9 is colorimetry only, so the conversion must happen in the player. UNKNOWN: the bdp_BDVD patch that makes the player output RGB; reverse engineering in progress. No release.
